@@ -122,11 +122,15 @@ An `{% inline %}` definition may declare a **parameter list** after its name:
 ```
 
 The signature is `( name ( , name ( = default )? )* )` — comma-separated parameter names, each with an
-optional default that is a **literal** (string/number/bool/null) or another in-scope nullary operation
-value. The body binds each parameter as a **local** sourced from the matching `{% include %}` hash
-argument; a parameter with no matching hash arg falls back to its default, and a parameter with
-**neither** a hash arg nor a default is a located error at the include site (the typed-macro contract
-Tera lacks).
+optional default that is a **literal** (string/number/bool/null). The body binds each parameter as a
+**local** sourced from the matching `{% include %}` hash argument; a parameter with no matching hash
+arg falls back to its default, and a parameter with **neither** a hash arg nor a default is a located
+error at the include site (the typed-macro contract Tera lacks).
+
+A default is *literal-only* — a bare, unquoted word is a located parse error, not a nullary-operation
+reference. (An earlier draft allowed "another in-scope nullary operation value"; that was dropped so a
+**typo'd default** — `badge=nwe` — fails at parse time rather than silently becoming an unknown-op
+reference that errors only when the partial renders. Typo-safety beats the niche capability.)
 
 - **Surface parse:** `MaxBars.Parser`'s inline-head parser (MaxBars owns its front-end per
   [ADR-041](/adr/adr-0041-per-surface-lexer-parser/)) gains an optional `( … )` after the partial
